environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (REST API) with Lambda proxy integration. The Lambda execution role has DynamoDB access with an IAM policy condition using dynamodb:LeadingKeys to restrict write operations. The condition enforces that the partition key (userId) in any PutItem/UpdateItem/DeleteItem request must match the value passed in the Lambda event's requestContext.identity.cognitoAuthenticationProvider resolved principal (mapped via a VTL request template that injects ${context.authorizer.claims.sub} as a request header X-Caller-Identity). The IAM policy condition: dynamodb:LeadingKeys ForAllValues:StringEquals to the caller's resolved sub claim. Additionally, the API Gateway method has a Cognito User Pool authorizer attached (not the Lambda's internal cookie check), meaning the session cookie alone cannot authenticate - a valid JWT id_token in the Authorization header is required. The Cognito authorizer validates token signature, expiry, and audience. Cross-origin requests from attacker domains cannot obtain or forge this JWT.

config.dynamodb_leading_keys_enforcement: userId partition key must equal authenticated caller sub
